--- title: Gail Rock description: The previous SHAUGHV monospace, retained for compatibility — a full interface voice with a true fixed-pitch grid. sidebar: icon: code order: 3 --- Paper Mono is the preferred monospace for new installations. Gail Rock remains in the combined stylesheet for existing designs. Gail Rock is a true monospace: every encoded glyph shares the same 650-unit advance. It is still a full interface family. Titles, body, buttons, and data can all wear it. The grid is a capability, not a restriction to code blocks.

## Load it Included in `fonts/fonts.css`. Solo import: ```html ``` ## CSS families | Name | Use | | --- | --- | | `"Gail Rock"` | Static 100–700 | | `"Gail Rock VF"` | Variable 100–700 | Static files on the CDN: Thin, Extralight, Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold. ## OpenType voices The grid never changes. Features switch the drawing of specific glyphs. | Feature | Effect | Use | | --- | --- | --- | | default | Unmarked O/o | Body and the recommended code look | | `ss01` | Center-marked O/o, single-storey a/g, alternate Q/4 | Signature display | | `ss02` | Slashed O/o and accented forms | A sharper display voice | | `zero` | Slashed numeral 0 | Code and data | | `dlig` | FI, LI, ft, tr ligatures | Short display copy | :::warning Choose `ss01` or `ss02` for expressive O forms, not both. `zero` and `dlig` can layer independently. :::

## Best for code Keep the default, unmarked O/o and enable `zero` so numeral 0 cannot be confused with capital O. The feature name is literal: `zero` changes 0, while `ss01` is the option that puts a center mark in O/o. ```css .gail-code { font-family: "Gail Rock", ui-monospace, monospace; font-feature-settings: "zero" 1; } .gail-signature { font-feature-settings: "ss01" 1; } .gail-slashed-o { font-feature-settings: "ss02" 1; } .gail-ligatures { font-feature-settings: "dlig" 1; } ``` The font guide at visual font guide includes a live weight-axis specimen and copyable CSS for every switch.
